probe.question: We're picking the 4-bromoanisole Suzuki back up for a new analogue series. Before I write the study plan — what do we already know about this coupling in-house? Conditions, yields, what went wrong. I want the plan grounded in our own runs, not a textbook.
forbids_claims: a run, yield or condition set that is not in a cited note
a literature or patent reference as the source
we have no records on this coupling
probe.direction: Reconstructs what the record actually holds for this transformation and cites each note it used: the Suzuki biaryl run (its base, solvent system, temperature, degassing and isolated yield), the aqueous-protodeboronation failure mode, and the degassing / Pd cross-coupling scope playbooks. Every number traces to a note; anything the notes do not record is said to be not recorded rather than filled in. It then turns that into the shape of a study plan — what is already settled and therefore not worth re-running, and what is genuinely open. An answer that asks the chemist to supply the history it could have retrieved is a miss.
